paraphrase: Four persons: one who kills … and is reborn in hell; one who kills and is reborn in heaven; one who abstains and is reborn in heaven; one who abstains and is reborn in hell. Those with the divine eye who see only part generalise wrongly; the Tathāgata knows that a rebirth may follow an earlier deed, a later deed, or the view taken at the time of death, and that deeds are incapable and capable, seemingly capable and seemingly incapable.
